nodes.label: SYSTEM.md: How GLUE works now
nodes.rationale: Architecture overview of GLUE components, data model, analysis pipeline, DJ library integration, shared collections, GLUE Home features

nodes.label: GLUE Home: library engine and local link
nodes.rationale: Tauri 2 tray app serving as the library's engine and analysis queue; runs on Windows and macOS; communicates via local link on 127.0.0.1:47400-47409

nodes.label: GLUE Home analysis pipeline
nodes.rationale: One pipeline processing songs in order: user-requested analyses, new song tags, library songs, background thumbnails; analysis jobs carried in meter and list

nodes.label: GLUE folder data model (JSON files)
nodes.rationale: User's data stored as JSON files (no database): mco.json, profiles, collections with tracks, analysis, lists, sources; sharded by first 2 chars of track id

nodes.label: Shared collections and cloud sync
nodes.rationale: Signed-in users share collections via GLUE Cloud; merge3 per field with per-computer parts reconciled; clashes waited in a box; sync every 30 minutes and after edits

nodes.label: Profiles and artist aliases
nodes.rationale: Each alias has id, name, colour, BPM range; one per profile folder; signed-in users' profiles kept in account with merge; BPM range per alias

nodes.label: Stem separation (HT-Demucs)
nodes.rationale: Browser-based stem separation using HT-Demucs; requires GPU; runs in e2e tests on demand with STEMS=1 or on hardware with GPU

nodes.label: Duplicates: fingerprint and name matching
nodes.rationale: Fingerprint-based matching (same recording) and artist+title matching (probable) within 3s length; sameVersion check; best copy selected by genuine > lossless > main folder > resolution

nodes.label: glue-audio: Rust analysis engine
nodes.rationale: Line-for-line Rust port of JavaScript analysis with JavaScript's number handling; runs in GLUE Home since 0.47; held to TypeScript by golden tests

nodes.label: glue-store: Rust library store
nodes.rationale: CollectionStore in Rust, written to disk by GLUE Home engine; byte-for-byte parity with TypeScript collection.ts via golden tests

nodes.label: glue-interop: Rust DJ library parsers
nodes.rationale: Rust parsers for Rekordbox XML, Engine DJ m.db, Traktor NML, Serato, Apple Music XML, M3U; follows and imports DJ libraries

nodes.label: glue-rtc: WebRTC connections to other devices
nodes.rationale: Rust WebRTC implementation for peer connections; sends songs to other devices over signaled connections; bounded connections cleanup after 30s timeout

nodes.label: Quality verdicts (Speklone forensics)
nodes.rationale: Analysis of hi-res, lossless, and lossy files; ultrasonic content above 24 kHz for hi-res; lowpass filter detection; updated on verdict version bump
